children: NEW YORK, Sept. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) (
) ("Eco Wave Power" or the "Company"), a pioneering onshore wave energy technology company, today announced that Founder and Chief Executive Officer
Inna Braverman has been invited to participate as a Luminary Speaker at the inaugural Futures: Ocean Forum
, taking place on September 24, 2026, in Newport, Rhode Island.

The high-level Forum will convene leaders, innovators, investors, researchers and public-sector stakeholders to explore the technologies, industries and ideas shaping the future of the ocean and the global blue economy. Discussions will span ocean technology, artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, defense, biotechnology, advanced materials and marine science, while highlighting Rhode Island's growing role as a center for ocean innovation.
Braverman was personally invited to participate following her recent engagement with
Rhode Island Secretary of Commerce Stefan Pryor and Rhode Island Commerce Chief Business Development Officer Jason Dodier
, bringing Eco Wave Power's perspective on ocean energy, technology commercialization and the role of the ocean in meeting growing global energy needs to the Forum.
The program will feature
Fabien Cousteau

, aquanaut and oceanographic explorer, Founder of Proteus Ocean Group and the Fabien Cousteau Ocean Learning Center, and grandson of legendary ocean explorer Jacques Cousteau. Rhode Island Governor Dan McKee is also scheduled to attend the Forum, alongside leaders from the state's ocean innovation, investment, research and public-sector communities.

"The Ocean State didn't get its name by accident. Hosting Eco Wave Power in Rhode Island is about turning that identity into infrastructure, proving that the smallest state can lead the biggest conversations about the future of ocean energy," said Jason Dodier, Chief Business Development Officer at Rhode Island Commerce.
"Rhode Island has built a remarkable ecosystem around the ocean, bringing together research institutions, government, investors, entrepreneurs and industry," said
Inna Braverman, Founder and CEO of Eco Wave Power

. "I am honored to have been invited as a Luminary Speaker to the inaugural Futures: Ocean Forum and to join Fabien Cousteau and other ocean innovators in discussing how we can transform the enormous potential of the ocean into technologies and industries that can shape our future."

"The ocean covers more than 70% of our planet, yet its potential as a source of clean energy remains largely untapped," Braverman continued. "At the same time, the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence, data centers and digital infrastructure is creating unprecedented electricity demand. We believe this convergence creates an important opportunity for technologies such as wave energy, and I look forward to bringing Eco Wave Power's experience and perspective to this conversation."
Rhode Island Identified as a Potential Market for Eco Wave Power
Rhode Island is of particular strategic interest to Eco Wave Power as the Company evaluates opportunities for the commercial deployment of its wave energy technology along the U.S. coastline.
As part of a feasibility study conducted by
Eco Wave Power and Shell Marine Renewable Energy
, potential locations along the U.S. coastline were evaluated for the deployment of Eco Wave Power's technology.
Sites in Rhode Island were identified among the locations considered particularly suitable for potential commercial-scale wave energy deployment
, based on factors relevant to the implementation of the Company's onshore technology.
Building on the findings of that work, during her visit to Rhode Island,

Braverman plans to visit two of the identified sites and meet with relevant state and local authorities and stakeholders to discuss the potential development of Eco Wave Power's first commercial wave energy project in Rhode Island.

"Rhode Island is particularly exciting for Eco Wave Power because our interest in the state goes well beyond participating in the Forum," said Braverman. "Our previous feasibility work with Shell identified promising locations in Rhode Island for the potential commercial deployment of our technology. I look forward to visiting these sites and meeting with the relevant authorities to explore what could become Eco Wave Power's first commercial project in the state."
Known as the
"Ocean State,"

Rhode Island offers a strong ecosystem of ocean research institutions, universities, naval and defense expertise, ocean technology companies, investors and a skilled workforce. Eco Wave Power believes the combination of
suitable coastal infrastructure, an established ocean innovation ecosystem and strong public-sector engagement
could make Rhode Island an attractive market for the Company's continued U.S. expansion.
Part of a Broader Rhode Island Ocean Innovation Week

The Futures: Ocean Forum will be interwoven into a broader week of innovation, investment and international business convenings across Rhode Island, bringing together investors, entrepreneurs, researchers, public officials and industry leaders from across the region and beyond.
Related events include
RI Startup Week's Ocean Tech Day
, which brings together participants from Rhode Island's growing ocean technology ecosystem; the
Newport Investor Summit and Regatta
, connecting investors, entrepreneurs and innovation leaders; and the
Global Trade Summit
, convening leaders around global markets, trade, technology and economic development.
Together, these events highlight Rhode Island's growing concentration of activity at the intersection of
ocean technology, entrepreneurship, investment, research and economic development

Advancing Eco Wave Power's U.S. Commercialization Strategy

Braverman's participation in the Forum, planned site visit and meetings with relevant authorities come as Eco Wave Power continues to expand its engagement with U.S. public-sector, port, technology and infrastructure stakeholders and evaluate opportunities to bring its patented onshore wave energy technology to additional U.S. coastal markets.

Eco Wave Power's technology converts ocean and sea waves into clean electricity using floaters installed on existing coastal infrastructure such as breakwaters, jetties and piers. This approach is designed to enable wave energy generation close to coastal cities, ports and other major electricity demand centers while utilizing existing marine infrastructure.
In the United States, Eco Wave Power has deployed its first onshore wave energy pilot project at the
Port of Los Angeles

, in collaboration with Shell Marine Renewable Energy and AltaSea. The planned Rhode Island discussions represent another step in the Company's strategy to evaluate pathways from demonstration projects toward larger-scale commercial deployments in the United States.

About Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ)
Eco Wave Power Global (

) is a pioneering onshore wave energy company that converts ocean and sea waves into clean, reliable, and cost-efficient electricity using its patented technology. By generating renewable power directly from existing coastal infrastructure such as breakwaters, jetties, and piers, Eco Wave Power enables sustainable electricity production in close proximity to coastal cities, ports, and energy-intensive infrastructure.

As global electricity demand continues to rise, driven in part by the rapid growth of artificial intelligence, data centers, and digital infrastructure, Eco Wave Power is positioning its technology as a scalable, nearshore renewable energy solution capable of supporting next-generation power needs.

With a mission to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy while supporting the next generation of digital and industrial infrastructure, Eco Wave Power developed and operates Israel's first grid-connected wave energy power station, recognized as a "Pioneering Technology" by the Israeli Ministry of Energy and co-funded by EDF Power Solutions. In the United States, the Company launched the first-ever onshore wave energy pilot station at the Port of Los Angeles, in collaboration with Shell Marine Renewable Energy.

Eco Wave Power is expanding globally with projects planned in Portugal, Taiwan, India and additional markets. The Company has received international recognition and support from organizations including the European Union Regional Development Fund, Innovate UK, and the EU Horizon 2020 program, and was honored with the United Nations Global Climate Action Award.
Eco Wave Power's American Depositary Shares (ADSs) are traded on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker symbol "WAVE."
